summary.zh: 渲染 3/4 总览、近景、低机位、线框四张图，交给独立的评审代理挑至少 3 个具体问题并打分，不合格按问题类型退回对应环节。
summary.en: Renders overview, close-up, low-angle and wireframe views; an independent critic lists at least three concrete flaws and scores the scene, routing failures back to the right step.

outputs.zh: 四视角截图、评分与问题清单
outputs.en: Four renders, score and flaw list

what.zh: 另开一个独立会话看四视角图打分、列问题、决定通过或退回
what.en: A separate session scores the four views, lists flaws and decides pass or route-back
